cv_explanation: 5-fold stratified cross-validation partitions the dataset into 5 balanced folds, fitting the preprocessing and estimator on 4 folds and validating on the remaining fold. This guarantees that evaluation is invariant to a single lucky or unlucky split, providing a mathematically grounded estimate of out-of-sample generalization.
